# SEO-167: Avoid emitting conflicting objects for the same entity

This page is generated from the canonical JSONL registry record. Edit the JSONL record and run `npm run docs -- --write`; do not edit this file directly.

| Field | Value |

| Confidence | `HIGH` |

## Statement

A page does not describe one thing twice with different values; where several blocks reference the same entity they share an @id and agree on every property they both assert.

## Rationale

Two descriptions of one thing force the consumer to pick between them, so a stale duplicate left behind by a second plugin or a legacy template can override the values the current template computes.

## Applicability

```json
{
  "all": [
    "public_site"
  ],
  "any": [
    "has_structured_data"
  ]
}
```

## Implementation

Compose one graph per page from a single generator and emit it in one block, rather than letting each component contribute its own block. Where a plugin adds markup you cannot remove, disable its output instead of emitting a second competing description.

## Verification

- Level: `SOURCE_AND_RUNTIME`
- Method: Group the parsed nodes by type and identifier and report groups holding more than one node with differing property values.
- Evidence: `JSON_LD`, `RENDERED_HTML`, `VALIDATOR_OUTPUT`
- Automated check: `jsonld-duplicate-entity`

- Search surfaces: `GOOGLE_SEARCH`, `BING_SEARCH`
- Frameworks: `any`
- Caution: none recorded.
